duration.value: 1 minute/level  DESCRIPTION You envelope yourself in protective mirages that acts more like a barrier. You gain 1d6 temporary hit points per two caster levels (Max 10d6). You can instead sacrifice these temporary hit points to give yourself a bonus on Reflex saving throws as a free action outside your turn. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Reflex saving throws per 5 points sacrificed but can only sacrifice an amount equal to 5x your casting modifier. This bonus lasts for 1 round.
